build_CompressedTensorsW8A16Fp8: build a CompressedTensorsW8A16Fp8 quantization scheme with channel or tensor strategy and optional static input scaling
create_weights_fp8_layer: create FP8 w8a16 quantized weights and scale parameters for a linear layer with specified partition sizes
process_weights_after_loading_fp8: process and transpose FP8 weights, convert scales to channelwise if needed, and prepare layer for marlin execution
apply_weights_fp8_marlin: apply FP8 marlin linear operation on input tensor with pre-quantized weights and scales
get_min_capability_fp8: get minimum GPU compute capability (80 for Ampere and up) required to run FP8 w8a16 quantization kernels
